LPL/2016/Summer.format:
* '''Group Stage'''
** 2 groups of 6 teams each.
** Each team plays 16 matches.
*** Double Round Robin within own group
*** Single Round Robin against other group
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place of each group''}} advance to the Semfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place of each group''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs, and will start the series with a 1-game advantage.
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th place of each group''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
** {{bgcolortext|staydown|''5th place of each group''}} will have to play in the [[LPL/2017/Spring/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]], and start in the Qualifying Round.
** {{bgcolortext|down|''6th place of each group''}} will have to play in the [[LPL/2017/Spring/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]], and start in the Elimination Round.
* '''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}}
* Winner qualifies for [[World Championship/2016|World Championship 2016]]

CBLOL/2016/Split 2.format:
*'''Group Stage'''
**Single round robin.
**Each match is a {{Abbr/Bo2}}. A win is 3 points, a draw is 1 point, and losing is 0 points.
**{{Bgcolortext|up|Top 4}} advance to the playoffs.
**{{Bgcolortext|stay|{{Ordinal|5}} place}} qualified for [[CBLOL/2017/Split 1|2017 Split 1]].
**{{Bgcolortext|staydown|{{Ordinal|6}} place}} plays in the [[CBLOL/2017/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion]].
**{{Bgcolortext|down|Bottom two}} play a [[CBLOL/2016/Winter/Relegation|relegation match]].
*'''Relegation'''
**Bottom two teams from Group Stage play a {{Abbr/Bo3}} match
**Winner plays in the [[CBLOL/2017/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion]].
**Loser is auto-relegated to [[BRCC/2017/Summer|BRCC]].
*'''Playoffs'''
**Single elimination bracket.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
**Winner qualifies to [[International Wildcard Qualifier/2016|International Wildcard Qualifier 2016]].

CBLOL/2016/Split 1.format:
*'''Group Stage'''
**Single Round Robin, {{Abbr/Bo2}}
**Top 6 advances to the playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''1st and 2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''5th and 6th place''}} advance to Round 1 of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|staydown|''7th and 8th place''}} will play a relegation match.
**** The winner of the relegation match will play in the [[CBLOL/2016/Split 2/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]]
**** The loser of the relegation match is auto relegated to [[Circuito Desafiante/2016/Split 2|Circuito Desafiante]]
*'''Playoffs'''
**Single Elimination bracket, {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
*** 3rd place is decided by tie-breaking rules
****# Total Wins in the Playoffs
****# Shortest combined game time (for wins)
****# Team's final placement in the regular season
*** Loser's of Quarterfinal will play a {{Abbr/Bo3}} to determine 5th place
**** 6th Place will have to play in the [[CBLOL/2016/Split 2/Promotion|Promotion Tournament]].
**Winner qualifies to [[International Wildcard Invitational/2016|International Wildcard Invitational 2016]].

World Championship/2016.format:
* '''Qualifiers''' - ''August 27th - September 5th, 2016''
** Five Regional Finals.
*** The winners of each Regional Final will advance to the World Championship.
**Two International Wildcard Qualifiers.
***The winner of each International Wildcard Qualifier will advance to the World Championship.
* '''Group Stage''' - ''September 29th - October 9th, 2016 in {{Flag|us}} San Francisco''
** All sixteen teams are divided into four groups where they play a Double Round robin format.
*** All Matches are played in a {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
*** The top two teams in each group advance to the Knockout Stage.
*** The remaining teams are eliminated.
* '''Knockout Stage''' - ''October 13th - October 29st, 2016 in {{Flag|us}} Chicago, {{Flag|us}} New York, and {{Flag|us}} Los Angeles''
** Eight teams play in a single elimination bracket over seven days.
*** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
